# Flow's Table (flowstable.vercel.app)

> A curated collective for no-agenda conversations and shared wisdom in Bangkok.

Flow's Table is a public website documenting community gatherings, field notes, reels, and guest stories from an intimate dinner-circle collective of builders, investors, and mentors.

## Public pages
- https://flowstable.vercel.app/
- https://flowstable.vercel.app/about
- https://flowstable.vercel.app/archive
- https://flowstable.vercel.app/reels
- https://flowstable.vercel.app/guests
